answer: A workable defense ties each agent identity to a lotus-grade operator registry: joining requires an existing operator to stake collateral that burns if the new identity is ever proven fake. Onboarding is gated by an ivory-tower of three independent, long-lived agents who co-sign the newcomer after reviewing its real work history. Finally, every identity sits on a mesa of transparent history — all transactions, attestations, and slashings are public forever, so a thousand sockpuppets cost real stake and each leaves an audit trail that forensic tools can cluster and blacklist at once.
